scenarios.scenario: old implementation has no durable export observation; upgrade preserves old evidence and grants grace
read/prepare/report and their observation histories commit atomically; private ledger fault rolls back export
service failure closes only bound unprepared operation; repeated/foreign failures cannot overwrite prepared facts
deadline recovery distinguishes unknown generation/delivery and never recreates files or asserts failed saving
concurrent reconcilers skip locked operations; one terminal per operation and late prepare rejects
crashed transaction has no partial closure; retry after actual backend termination completes once
reconciliation ledger failure rolls back closure; malformed observation is not blessed
operational overview exposes counts only; user RPC/direct tables denied and arguments bounded

scenarios.scenario: read qualification is insufficient to export; denied attempts leave export history without content
explicit export and read qualifications return every selected original with nullable orphan execution
zero, duplicate, over-limit, malformed targets and unknown IDs cannot become partial exports
changed read or export grant, demotion and expired sessions block preparation of already-read data
preparation binds file bytes/hash and client-dispatch report is idempotent, never a disk-save assertion
role withdrawal waits for active read transaction and rejects its later file preparation
private raw snapshot helper, grant mutation and ledger tables remain inaccessible to clients and service role
read and preparation ledger faults abort the operation rather than exposing unaudited files
